title: Aetheria Narrative Spot
description: Atmospheric cinematic visual poetry exploring amber light diffusion, mist dynamics, and photorealistic talent performance for luxury perfume launch.
overview: Directed and generated an atmospheric mood film capturing golden hour amber perfume bottles against Mediterranean coastlines.
challenge: Capturing cinematic coastal lighting with golden reflections and mist in live production takes full crew transport and unpredictable weather delays.
solution: Built dynamic camera motion paths in Runway Gen-3 and blended particle physics in DaVinci Resolve.
